newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria buys Canadian durum - Euro traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria buys Canadian durum - Euro traders.

text.p: Algeria has bought at least 50,000 tonnes of Canadian durum wheat for June and July shipment at a tender, European grain traders said on Thursday.
Some trade sources put the volume at 75,000 tonnes.
The price of the deals was not available.
Algeria tendered two days ago for 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin durum wheat.
The tender was for four equal shipments of 25,000 tonnes, with two cargoes to be shipped in the second half of June and the rest in the first half of July.
